'''September 2000 Kingman tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Kingman, AZ on 16 September 2000. [[Tim Guzman]] won it. It is known from Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1232">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-kingman-az-sept-162kd1232/ kingman-az-sept-162k], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 16 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-kingman-az-sept-162kd1232/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Kingman, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Tim Guzman]]
